name: Zei
about: Costume test: the starting Zei profile redesigned with future Dzego techwear instead of present-day clothes. Same invented face and build.
descriptor: a young man of eighteen, slim and of medium height, light golden-tan skin, spiky jet-black hair with one electric-blue streak and quick dark eyes, wearing modular techwear: a cropped orange shell jacket with reflective piping and magnetic clasps, a black high-neck base layer, segmented grey cargo trousers with strap pockets, chunky white sneakers with glowing soles, a thin band around his throat and clear smart glasses pushed up on his head
